fields.description: Delivery lifecycle status, set by the system: Pending/Queued are awaiting processing, Drafted is stored on the server, Submitted is handed over for delivery (the server may still hold it until Send At; Cancelled At records a cancelled hold), and the Failed states are eligible for retry.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Queued
Failed
Drafted
Failed to Draft
Submitted
Failed to Submit

fields.description: Display name used in the From header. Defaults to the sending identity's name.
fields.label: From Name

fields.description: Sender address. Must match one of the account's identities.
fields.label: From Email

fields.description: Subject line of the email.
fields.label: Subject

fields.description:
Provide a JSON array of objects with display_name and email.
Example: [{"display_name": "Jane Smith", "email": "jane@example.com"}]
fields.label: Reply To

fields.description:
Provide a JSON object with header name–value pairs.
Example: {"X-Custom-Header": "Value"}
fields.label: Headers

fields.description:
Provide a JSON array of recipients with type, display_name, and email.
type must be "To", "Cc", or "Bcc".
Example: [{"type": "To", "display_name": "Jane Smith", "email": "jane@example.com"}]
fields.label: Recipients

fields.description: HTML body of the email.
fields.label: HTML

fields.description: Plain-text alternative body of the email.
fields.label: Text

fields.description:
Provide a JSON array with file_url, disposition (inline or attachment), and cid.
Example: [{"file_url": "/private/files/image.png", "disposition": "inline", "cid": "j80BhiEC5o"}]
fields.label: Attachments

fields.description: RFC 5322 Message-ID. Generated automatically if left empty.
fields.label: Message ID

fields.description: JMAP blob id of the stored message, used to fetch the raw MIME content.
fields.label: Blob ID

fields.description: Value of the RFC 5322 Date header. Defaults to the creation time. Not the delivery time — see Send At (Scheduled).
fields.label: Sent At

fields.description: JMAP id of the mailbox currently holding the message: Drafts while drafted, Sent after submission, and back to Drafts when a scheduled delivery is cancelled.
fields.label: Mailbox ID

fields.description: JMAP thread id assigned by the server.
fields.label: Thread ID

fields.description: Full RFC 5322 MIME message. When set, it is imported as-is and the individual content fields (subject, bodies, recipients, etc.) are derived from it instead.
fields.label: Raw Message

fields.description: The stored MIME message, fetched from the server on demand via the blob id.
fields.label: Message

fields.description: The server's JMAP response, formatted for reading.
fields.label: Response

fields.description: Raw JMAP response captured at processing time.
fields.label: Response

fields.description: Human-readable error extracted from the JMAP response.
fields.label: Error Message

fields.description: When checked, the email will be saved as a draft instead of being sent.
fields.label: Save as Draft

fields.description: Message-ID of the email being replied to, used by the server to thread them together.
fields.label: In Reply To (Message ID)

fields.description: Size of the stored message in bytes, as reported by the server.
fields.label: Size

fields.description: When the draft was stored on the server.
fields.label: Drafted At

fields.description: When the email was submitted for delivery.
fields.label: Submitted At

fields.description: When the held (scheduled or undo-send) delivery was cancelled — the submission itself is the source of truth.
fields.label: Cancelled At

fields.description:
Immediate — send right after insert (after_insert).
Enqueue — enqueue a job (using frappe.enqueue).
Batch — wait to be picked up by a scheduled background job.
fields.label: Delivery Mode

fields.description: Scheduled delivery time (FUTURERELEASE) — the server holds delivery until then. Distinct from Sent At, which is the RFC 5322 Date header.
fields.label: Send At (Scheduled)

fields.description: Traceback of the last processing failure.
fields.label: Error Log

fields.description: Earliest time the next automatic retry may run. The gap grows with each attempt.
fields.label: Next Retry After

fields.description: When the email was queued for background processing.
fields.label: Queued At

fields.description: JMAP email id of the message being replied to. It is marked $answered on submission.
fields.label: In Reply To (Email ID)

fields.description: JMAP email id of the message being forwarded. It is marked $forwarded on submission.
fields.label: Forwarded From (Email ID)

fields.description: Submitted At - Creation
fields.label: Submitted After (Seconds)

fields.description: Queued At - Creation
fields.label: Queued After (Seconds)

fields.description: Drafted At - Creation
fields.label: Drafted After (Seconds)

fields.description: Creation - Sent At
fields.label: Received After (Seconds)

fields.description: IP address of the request that created this email.
fields.label: From IP

fields.description: Set when the email was created through the public outbound API.
fields.label: API

fields.description: Marks a bulk (newsletter) email: delivered in batch mode and defaulting to Low priority.
fields.label: Newsletter

fields.description: Delivery priority, sent as the SMTP MT-PRIORITY envelope parameter (Low −4, Normal 0, High 4). Defaults to Low for newsletters, otherwise Normal.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Number of failed processing attempts so far.
fields.label: Retries

fields.description: Maximum automatic retries before the email stays failed.
fields.label: Max Retries

fields.description: JMAP email id assigned by the server.
fields.label: Mail ID

fields.description: JMAP EmailSubmission id of the latest submission — the source of truth for a held (scheduled) delivery's state.
fields.label: Submission ID

fields.description: If enabled, the message will be deleted after successful submission.
fields.label: Destroy After Submit

fields.description: The user whose JMAP credentials are used to send this message.
fields.label: User

fields.description: The JMAP account the email is sent from.
fields.label: Account
